description:
The kid who is always in the middle.  A kid who works hard.  So-ra Song, a web novelist who is okay with everything after all.  He meets the national MC Ondo-hyeok, who is loved by everyone, and rises to unexpected stardom...  !  Will the jackpot life I so longed for begin?  A story about work, talent and love.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=808677), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9662012)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003119), [Thai](https://www.webtoons.com/th/romance/the-greatest-rock-snails/list?title_no=6688)
